row: Relax Wichita - Regenerate with Massage Therapy

Relax Wichita brings massage therapy and self-care to the Wichita community. Rianne is a Licensed Massage Therapist that shares her self-care tips, tricks, and provides information about massage therapy. Relax Wichita focuses on massage for mental health and helps busy professionals increase their productivity, reduce their stress, and feel better with massage.
